notes: Titleman is an AI engine for real estate firms, lenders, developers and brokers. It reads what your team already works in (mail, data rooms, Excel models, CRM) and runs underwriting, value opinion, feasibility and deal review on top, with a source and a date on every input. It keeps one property record per address and measures 1,854 U.S. counties every hour. Weekly Signals list the properties in your territory where something just changed. Built for acquisitions, asset management, brokerage and lending teams in the US and Europe. See a worked example: https://titleman.ai/demo
